pool.text: The French East India Company ship arrived at Phuket island and departed with tin cargo.
King Narai granted the French a tin monopoly in Phuket through an agreement.
Desfarges led a military expedition to recapture Thalang and re-establish French control.
Francis Light alerted Phuket authorities of the impending Burmese attack before the assault.
Monthon Phuket was dissolved, leading to Phuket's establishment as a separate province.
Thailand initiated the installation of tsunami-detection buoys in response to the disaster.
The Supreme Patriarch of Thailand designated the Phuket Big Buddha as a treasure.
Aquaria Phuket officially opened to the public on August 24.
The COVID-19 pandemic reached Phuket during the early part of the year.
Nicole Sauvain-Weisskopf, a Swiss national on holiday, was murdered in Phuket.
Thailand transitioned towards the post-pandemic phase, ending intensive COVID-19 response measures.
